paragraph: SS-1 USS Holland was the Navy's first submarine. Designer John Holland began sketching submarine designs as early as 1869 and built five experimental submarines between 1878 and 1895 before arriving at the more successful Holland design. The vessel included dual propulsion systems, separate main and auxiliary ballast systems, a fixed center of gravity, a hydrodynamic shape, and a modern weapons system—incorporating all the major components that would define modern submarines.
